import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    crm_feed = inputs["crm_feed"].copy()
    web_feed = inputs["web_feed"].copy()
    
    # Step 1: Add source rank
    crm_feed["src_rank"] = 1
    web_feed["src_rank"] = 2
    
    # Step 2: UNION ALL
    stg_combined = pd.concat([crm_feed, web_feed], ignore_index=True)
    
    # Step 3: Apply ROW_NUMBER with partition and order
    # Order by src_rank ASC, updated_at DESC, email ASC
    stg_combined = stg_combined.sort_values(
        by=["customer_id", "src_rank", "updated_at", "email"],
        ascending=[True, True, False, True]
    )
    
    # Apply row_number within each customer_id partition
    stg_combined["rn"] = stg_combined.groupby("customer_id", sort=False).cumcount() + 1
    
    # Step 4: Filter to keep only rn = 1
    golden = stg_combined[stg_combined["rn"] == 1].copy()
    
    # Step 5: Select only the required columns
    golden = golden[["customer_id", "email", "updated_at"]].reset_index(drop=True)
    
    return {"golden": golden}
